payload.body: Done in a63d803, which closes the open point in my ISSUE:0003 handover. The switch already took <file>.lock with Lock::acquire at 10 s stale, re-reading under the lock and changing only oauthAccount. It now saves as Claude Code does, through write_atomic: a 0600 temp file beside the config, renamed over it. So storage::replace, which kept the old mode, is gone, and storage.rs is as it was before shared mode. The critical section is a read, a merge and a rename. New test: shared_mode_use_waits_for_claude_codes_settings_lock holds .claude.json.lock as Claude Code would; use waits with the file untouched and goes on once the lock is free, and with the lock pointed elsewhere it fails. One edge from your note is left alone: a non-empty legacy .config.json would win over .claude.json. hv has none; say if you want doctor to warn of it.
